name: Walter Kohn
summary: Theoretical physicist known for density functional theory and solid-state physics.

summary: Co-author of the obituary and researcher at Vienna University of Technology.

name: Lu J. Sham
summary: Co-author of the obituary and collaborator on Kohn-Sham equations.

summary: Expert in variational methods and Walter Kohn's Ph.D. adviser at Harvard.

summary: Collaborator with Walter Kohn at Bell Telephone Laboratories.
